title: ornithogalum gussonei
intro: Ornithogalum gussonei, commonly known as Star of Persia, is a flowering plant species in the Asparagaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of Ornithogalum gussonei are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include saponins, flavonoids, and alkaloids. However, further research is needed to confirm its efficacy and safety for medicinal use.
